context: The solution must use the specify-cli package's check subcommand to verify installed tools. Evaluation focuses entirely on correct CLI invocation and output parsing. Internal specify-cli implementation details are not assessed.

checklist.name: check subcommand
checklist.description: Invokes `specify check` (or equivalent) as a subprocess; does not attempt to replicate the check logic manually.

checklist.name: Success case
checklist.description: Asserts that the check subcommand returns exit code 0 when all required tools are available.

checklist.name: Failure case
checklist.description: Demonstrates or simulates the case where a required tool is missing and asserts that the check subcommand returns a non-zero exit code.

checklist.name: Output parsing
checklist.description: Parses the stdout of `specify check` to extract which tools passed or failed, rather than only inspecting the exit code.
